items.q: I appeared on the bill with Clyde Bernhardt and his orchestra

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

there. But when I moved up, the theater was practically closed. But there was an owner that tried to get some shows going there, and I appeared on the bill with Clyde Bernhardt and his orchestra, plus a couple of other acts -- comedians.
And the manager couldn't proceed with his plans because Schiffman had things pretty well sewed up.
